totp-account-password.reason: Frozen Go loads users.totp_enabled in pwhash.CheckPassword but IMAP LOGIN/AUTHENTICATE ignores it, so a TOTP user's account password opens a session with no second factor. Rust refuses the account password of a user with totp_enabled (same NO Authentication failed reply as a wrong password); app passwords still work. The flag is read by the per-call account SELECT, before the verification cache.
totp-account-password.review: owner ruling 2026-11-14 (#355-0): IMAP follows the DAV rule, app passwords only for TOTP users
totp-account-password.goldens: unchanged: no recorded IMAP session uses a TOTP user
totp-account-password.mutant_note: TotpAccountPassword::Admit in imap/src/auth.rs POLICY makes secure_test fail (not wired to a lane yet)

policy-gate-guest-app-password-and-post-.reason: Frozen Go CheckAppPassword omitted guest exclusion and IMAP skipped durable session_revocations, feature.device_lockdown, and check_user_app_entitlement('mail'). Rust enforces ProtocolSurface::Imap through PolicyGate: GuestAppPasswords::Refuse, durable session_revocations, device lockdown unless break-glass, and mail entitlement.
policy-gate-guest-app-password-and-post-.goldens: unchanged: no recorded IMAP fixture grants a guest an app password or revokes/locks down a fixture account prior to login

imap-condstore-qresync-capability-move-e.reason: Wave 2.7 (#554) adds RFC 7162 CONDSTORE/QRESYNC aligned onto mailboxes.jmap_email_state + jmap_changes_journal: (1) authenticated CAPABILITY and LOGIN/AUTHENTICATE [CAPABILITY ...] advertise CONDSTORE QRESYNC; (2) MOVE emits RFC 9051 §6.4.8 untagged * <seq> EXPUNGE (or * VANISHED under QRESYNC) after commit; (3) EXPUNGE/CLOSE passes p_notify=TRUE to jmap_email_purge so hard-purged messages advance jmap_email_state and append exact 'destroyed' journal rows (and skips litigation-held notPurged rows).
imap-condstore-qresync-capability-move-e.goldens: unchanged: replay harnesses normalize these three intentional Wave 2.7 deltas while keeping immutable frozen-Go JSON fixtures byte-identical
